name: paxaver
description: Paxaver school community platform for lunch, events, programs, and wallet.

interface.longDescription: Paxaver connects ChatGPT to your Paxaver school community account. Parents and guardians can check lunch menus, order and cancel lunch, review wallet balance and transactions, register for fundraising events, enroll students in school programs, and sign up to volunteer. School administrators can manage restaurants, menu items, events, attendee check-in, volunteer shifts, program waitlists, and daily orders. Every action runs as the signed-in user through OAuth, with that user's own permissions. Requires an active Paxaver account.
defaultPrompt: Order lunch for my child today.
